ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio favoring high-intensity white pixels (estimated 80%) against low-intensity black pixels (estimated 20%) localized at the periphery and peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones dominate the central surface of both lobes. Low-intensity black zones form a continuous band along the trailing edges and vertical central peduncle. Isolated focal spots are visible on the inner left lobe and lower inner right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree pixel angle and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Deep secondary indentations (notches) are present on both the left and right trailing edges between the median notch and the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge displays a sigmoid curve; convex curvature near the median notch transitioning to concave curvature toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, circular pixel groups (barnacles) are situated on the low-intensity distal tips of both lobes; the left tip exhibits a denser cluster of approximately 8-10 units.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical low-intensity linear streaks on the high-intensity white surface: one prominent streak on the left inner lobe and a set of at least three parallel streaks on the right inner lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; distinct mechanical notches and irregular peaks along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent vertical black linear mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe white pigmentation area.
